title: Argentinian Beef Empanadas with Dijon Mustard
description: A twist on traditional Chinese empanadas, featuring the flavors of Argentina.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Stir in the Dijon mustard and cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Brush the edges of the Argentinian wraps with water.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each wrap.
Fold the wraps in half to form triangles and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with olive oil and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm with a sprinkle of shredded cheese and chopped green onion.
